After being treated with saturated aqueous Na 2S2O3 solu-
tion, the mixture wasextracted with ether. The organic
layer was subsequently washed with water and brine and
dried over Na
2SO4. After evaporation, the residue was puri-
fied via flash chromatography on a silica gel (petroleum
ether/ethyl acetate =10/1) to afford Z-2a asan oil; yield:
75 mg (77%). 1H NMR (300 MHz, CDCl 3): d =7.40–7.28
(m, 3H), 7.27–7.17 (m, 2H), 6.71 (s, 1H), 6.09 (s, 1H), 2.30
(t, J =7.5 Hz, 2H), 2.25 (br, 1H), 1.68–1.50 (m, 2H), 1.434
(s, 3H), 1.428 (s, 3H), 0.91 (t, J =7.2 Hz, 3H);
13C NMR
(75.4 MHz, CDCl3): d =14.0, 20.6, 26.9, 29.5, 29.8, 75.5, 82.2,
124.4, 126.4, 126.7, 128.7, 129.1, 134.7, 159.6, 173.9; MS
(ESI): m/z =430 [M +NH
4]+, 413 [M + +1]; IR (neat): n =
3447, 1743, 1670, 1496, 1456, 1363, 1118 cm /C01; HR-MS:
